shipped.title: Panel hotkeys reach ScapeLite panels

shipped.summary: The game's left-strip windows as buttons in an Info Bar, with hotkeys.

shipped.title: One stacking order for panels and game windows
shipped.summary: The last panel or window you touched is on top.

shipped.title: Game player menu on right-click in ScapeLite lists
shipped.summary: Friends, clan, muted and chat names open the game's own player menu.

shipped.title: Chat: 19 message-type filters

shipped.title: Skills card: click a skill opens its window

Diary card: full list with sort
Barter card: header tooltips and gold
